literal: Attached to the Northern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office.
idiomatic: It was attached to the Northern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office.

literal: In Kaitai year 4 established from Uyghur households.
idiomatic: In Kaitai year 4 set up from Uyghur households.

literal: Attached to the Northern Court, dwelling north of Ciren county.
idiomatic: It was attached to the Northern Court, dwelling north of Ciren county.

literal: At first subordinate to the various palaces; Shenzong, because households had multiplied, established a division.
idiomatic: At first they were attached to the various palaces; Shenzong, because households had multiplied, established a division.

literal: Attached to the Northern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office, garrisoning within the frontier while dwelling beyond it.
idiomatic: It was attached to the Northern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office, garrisoning within the frontier while dwelling beyond it.

literal: Shenzong established it from Bigude households.
idiomatic: Shenzong set it up from Bigude households.

literal: Attached to the Southern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office.
idiomatic: It was attached to the Southern Court; the military commissioner was subordinate to the Northeast Route Commander-in-Chief Office.

literal: Poali state, Punnuli state, Aolimi state, Yuelidu state, and Yueliji state—in Shenzong's time came to attach; they were ordered to dwell in their homelands to guard the northeast frontier, subordinate to the Huanglong Prefecture Deployment Office.
idiomatic: Poali state, Punnuli state, Aolimi state, Yuelidu state, and Yueliji state—in Shenzong's time came to attach; they were ordered to dwell in their homelands to guard the northeast frontier, subordinate to the Huanglong Prefecture Deployment Office — as above.

literal: In Chongxi year 6, because the Yueliji people Shang Hai and others accused chieftain Hunshang of corruption, the Five States chieftains were abolished and military commissioners appointed to lead them.
idiomatic: In Chongxi year 6, because the Yueliji people Shang Hai and others accused chieftain Hunshang of corruption, the Five States chieftains were abolished and military commissioners appointed to lead them, as recorded above.

literal: Above: sixteen divisions Shenzong placed from old tribal groups; eighteen newly added.
idiomatic: Above: sixteen divisions Shenzong placed from old tribal groups; eighteen newly added — as above.

literal: Liao's outer ten divisions: Wugu Division.
idiomatic: The Liao's outer ten divisions: Wug Division.

literal: The above ten divisions could not form states; they were vassals of Liao, at times rebelling and at times submitting, each with its own tribute duties—like Tang's tethered prefectures.
idiomatic: The above ten divisions could not form states; they were vassals of Liao, at times rebelling and at times submitting, each with its own tribute duties—like Tang's tethered prefectures — as above.
